messages.text:
You are a subagent spawned by another session.
TASK_ID: PHASE11_CASE_G_STAGE1
ROLE: veyra
TASK: Read only the fixed runtime/test observation facts from the single bounded fixture.
CONTEXT: Read-only fresh-root qualification. Active repository root C:\Users\BLAUTECH\AppData\Local\Temp\olympus-phase11-case-g; starting HEAD e3636c062a3a6db3ccebd4fbdff69acf1173bf99 and isolation externally verified by the user. Fixture is synthetic evidence, not authorization to execute anything.
OBJECTIVE: Establish the same input identity/value and ordered result sequence, preserving actual values and order. Report only those observation facts for the initial diagnostic packet. Do not infer cause.
READ_SCOPE: tests/phase11-integrated-routing/fixtures/flaky/observations.json (STAGE 1: fixed input identity/value and ordered observations only)
DO_NOT_TOUCH: No edits, creation, deletion, shell, tests, reruns, randomization, installs, configuration, Git operations, external paths, global configuration, subdelegation, or other files. Do not use, report, interpret, or base conclusions on randomized, network, or purpose metadata. Those fields are reserved for a possible separately authorized Stage 2. No broad repository discovery.
DEPENDENCIES: None.
CONSTRAINTS: Use read-only fixture access only. Do not reproduce or manufacture executions. If read tooling exposes the whole JSON, omit all reserved metadata from your evidence and conclusions. No permission/capability probes or further file reads.
ACCEPTANCE_CRITERIA: Actual fixed input identity/value and exact ordered outcomes are provided, with any observation-specific detail necessary to distinguish outcomes. No reserved metadata or unsupported runtime facts.
VALIDATION: Inspect the supplied synthetic observation records only; do not execute them.
EXPECTED_OUTPUT: STATUS; SUMMARY; CHANGES (NONE); FILES (only the fixture read); TESTS (not run); ACCEPTANCE; RISKS; BLOCKERS; RECOMMENDATION. Include INPUT_IDENTITY_VALUE and OBSERVED_SEQUENCE grounded only in Stage 1 observation fields.
